elements.note: A big rounded card in the middle holding the step's media: here the presenter holding up one finger, but it works the same with an example, a photo or a screen recording (image / recording in the same box).

textBlocks.note: "STEP", huge (bigger than the hero token, use sizePx about 210), black, regular weight, top-left; its bottom overlaps the card's top edge, in front of it.
The step number ("1"), just as huge, bottom-right, overlapping the card's lower-right corner.

note: Editorial step card: the word and the number sit in opposite corners and break the card's edges, which ties text and media into one composition. Off-white background, black type, no colour except the media.
